{1c:1e}{0b:08}【 聖者ウェルカイル 】{0b:09}
くっ、誰だ!?{0c:fe}
strings.en:
{1c:1e}{0b:08}【 Saint Welkail 】{0b:09}
Ngh, who is there!?{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Ngh, who is there!?

strings.read:
{0c:52b0b8}{1c:16}{0b:08}【 不死者ファトゥム 】{0b:09}
やはり届かぬか・・・{0c:2b5a09fe}
strings.en:
{0c:52b0b8}{1c:16}{0b:08}【 Fatum the Undying 】{0b:09}
So it falls short after all...{0c:2b5a09fe}
strings.tl: So it falls short after all...
Wh-why are you here!?
Be not dismayed, Welkail. That one is a puppet with no soul... Struggle as it may, it can never become the Devil.
You seem at ease. Think you are a god already?

strings.read:
{1c:17}{10}、この槍を持て!
これで奴の心臓を貫け!{0c:2b5709fe}
strings.en:
{1c:17}{10}, take this spear! Drive it
through that one's heart!{0c:2b5709fe}
strings.tl: [HERO], take this spear! Drive it through that one's heart!
Regrettably, I will not let you kill the Prophet yet. // [1]It is we who spin the world. The Prophet, and the Devil too, are no more than tools to that end.
How unfortunate for you. [1]But I will be removing this unplanned presence right here and now.

strings.en:
{1c:18}{0b:08}【 Fatum the Undying 】{0b:09}
Ugh!!{0c:2b5609fe}
strings.tl: Ugh!!
The s-spear!!
I-impossible!! // Why... Why should the Prophet's barrier fall so easily...

strings.read:
{1c:10}{0b:08}【 クムラン 】{0b:09}
これが人の力ですよ。{0c:2b5a09fe}
strings.en:
{1c:10}{0b:08}【 Qumran 】{0b:09}
This is the strength of humankind.{0c:2b5a09fe}
strings.tl: This is the strength of humankind.
I-impossible!! The second Prophet's death is not due until later...
Hearts that care for their companions proved stronger than the fate you believe in... // It is a well-worn phrase, but I can give no other answer.

strings.read:
{1c:1b}{0b:08}【 聖者バルカイル 】{0b:09}
そんな馬鹿な・・・{0c:2b5309fe}
strings.en:
{1c:1b}{0b:08}【 Saint Barkail 】{0b:09}
That can't be...{0c:2b5309fe}
strings.tl: That can't be...
To deny gods and legends: that is the answer I have reached. // Your god, your justice and your truth, we have no more need of them.

You founded the Anoian faith and planted a single universal set of values in people, // you showed the whole world the dream of eternal life, // and all of it was to give humankind the illusion called the 'New World'...

strings.en:
{1c:1b}{0b:08}【 Saint Barkail 】{0b:09}
Illusion... you say?{0c:2b5309fe}
strings.tl: Illusion... you say?

strings.jp:
{0c:51502b581000}{1c:11}{0b:08}{e080} クムラン {e081}{0b:09}
人{e0a2}{e0a3}{e0a4}の理想が存{e08c}することが
悪いことだとは思いません。{1a}ですが、その幻想に縛られ
{e0a6}人{e0a6}人の自由が無くなっては
その理想もただの悪弊となります。{1a}まして、その実{e0a8}のために人の命を
簡単に{e0a9}えたり奪うなど・・・
私達はあなた方を断じて認めません!{0c:2b5809fe}
strings.read:
{0c:51502b581000}{1c:11}{0b:08}【 クムラン 】{0b:09}
人類共通の理想が存在することが
悪いことだとは思いません。{1a}ですが、その幻想に縛られ
個人個人の自由が無くなっては
その理想もただの悪弊となります。{1a}まして、その実現のために人の命を
簡単に与えたり奪うなど・・・
私達はあなた方を断じて認めません!{0c:2b5809fe}
strings.en:
{0c:51502b581000}{1c:11}{0b:08}【 Qumran 】{0b:09}
I do not say it is wrong for humanity to
share an ideal.{1a}But when that illusion binds people and
strips each one of their freedom, the
ideal becomes nothing but a blight.{1a}And to give and take human lives so
lightly in order to achieve it... We will
never accept you!{0c:2b5809fe}
strings.tl: I do not say it is wrong for humanity to share an ideal. // But when that illusion binds people and strips each one of their freedom, the ideal becomes nothing but a blight. // And to give and take human lives so lightly in order to achieve it... We will never accept you!
Is that all you have to say, you enemies of God!
As promised, I will let you fight God. Come, then, to the 'Land of Origin'.
Madness! The light has not yet gone out. They must not be allowed to go!
Of course I have not given up on the coming of the 'New World'. // But I find I wish to test it: this truth they speak of. // [1]Besides, that one has earned the right.

strings.en:
{1c:1b}{0b:08}【 Saint Barkail 】{0b:09}
And yet...{0c:2b5709fe}
strings.tl: And yet...

strings.jp:
{1c:19}{0b:08}{e080} 聖者アヴァダイル {e081}{0b:09}
下がれ、バルカイル。{0c:fe}
strings.read:
{1c:19}{0b:08}【 聖者アヴァダイル 】{0b:09}
下がれ、バルカイル。{0c:fe}
strings.en:
{1c:19}{0b:08}【 Saint Avadail 】{0b:09}
Stand down, Barkail.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Stand down, Barkail.
Our truth lies beyond this gate. Come, young one.

strings.en:
{1c:13}{0b:08}【 Sadiya the Poisoner 】{0b:09}
...!!!{0c:2b5309fe}

{0c:51502b551000}{1c:11}{0b:08}【 Qumran 】{0b:09}
Tiara-san, please look after them.{0c:2b5509fe}
strings.tl: Tiara-san, please look after them.
O-okay!

strings.en:
{1c:23}{0b:08}【 Dias 】{0b:09}
This place...{0c:fe}
strings.tl: This place...

strings.jp:
{1c:1f}{0b:08}{e080} 初老の男 {e081}{0b:09}
ディアスとは其方のことか?{0c:fe}
strings.read:
{1c:1f}{0b:08}【 初老の男 】{0b:09}
ディアスとは其方のことか?{0c:fe}
strings.en:
{1c:1f}{0b:08}【 Aging Man 】{0b:09}
So you are the one called Dias?{0c:fe}
strings.tl: So you are the one called Dias?

strings.jp:
{1c:1f}今日から其方は
ジェオルジウスと{e0a0}乗れ。
そしてサン・タンジェロ城に
入ってもらう。{0c:fe}
strings.read:
{1c:1f}今日から其方は
ジェオルジウスと名乗れ。
そしてサン・タンジェロ城に
入ってもらう。{0c:fe}
strings.tl: From this day you shall call yourself Georgius. And you shall enter the Castel Sant'Angelo.

strings.jp:
{0c:52ff81ff89}{1c:1f}{e0bc}気のない顔立ちよのう・・・{1a}まあいい、あの城に2{e0bd}もいれば
惰弱な心など消え失せよう。{1a}父のために働け。
働き次第では、枢機卿の座さえも
掴むことが出来るぞ。{0c:fe}
strings.read:
{0c:52ff81ff89}{1c:1f}覇気のない顔立ちよのう・・・{1a}まあいい、あの城に2年もいれば
惰弱な心など消え失せよう。{1a}父のために働け。
働き次第では、枢機卿の座さえも
掴むことが出来るぞ。{0c:fe}
strings.en:
{0c:52ff81ff89}{1c:1f}A spiritless face you have...{1a}Well, no matter. Two years in that castle
will rid you of any weakness of heart.{1a}Serve your father. If you serve well,
even a cardinal's seat may be within
your grasp.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: A spiritless face you have... // Well, no matter. Two years in that castle will rid you of any weakness of heart. // Serve your father. If you serve well, even a cardinal's seat may be within your grasp.

strings.en:
{1c:1f}A courtesan with a child would find her
trade difficult. Consider it God's mercy.{0c:2b5e09fe}
strings.tl: A courtesan with a child would find her trade difficult. Consider it God's mercy.

strings.jp:
{1c:1f}其方の息子ディアスは死んだ。
其方も分かっておるとは思うが、
2度と息子に{e0c6}うことはならぬ。
このことを口外することも禁ずる。{0c:fe}
strings.read:
{1c:1f}其方の息子ディアスは死んだ。
其方も分かっておるとは思うが、
2度と息子に会うことはならぬ。
このことを口外することも禁ずる。{0c:fe}
strings.en:
{1c:1f}Your son Dias is dead. As I trust you
understand, you are never to see him
again. Nor are you to speak of this
to anyone.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Your son Dias is dead. As I trust you understand, you are never to see him again. Nor are you to speak of this to anyone.

strings.en: {0c:52ffa1ffa9}{1c:1f}A wise woman.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: A wise woman.
Sorry, Georgius. [1]You're a bit too sharp. You're an eyesore, so you're going to die.

strings.jp:
{0c:52d0d8}{1c:20}なに意外そうな顔をしてる?
{e095}{e0c9}庁の中では
他人を信じるなって言ったはずだ。{1a}{0c:52e0e8}{e0cb}に、俺達兄弟の間なんて
赤の他人より信用出来ない。
あの女好きの親父がそこら中に
子供をつくったおかげでな。{1a}{0c:52f0f8}みんな必死なんだよ。
3番目の兄貴みたいに、
親父に認められて
枢機卿になれたなら、{1a}{0c:52ff01ff09}アスロイトの四{e0d0}爵に匹敵する
富が手に入るんだからな。{0c:fe}
strings.read:
{0c:52d0d8}{1c:20}なに意外そうな顔をしてる?
教皇庁の中では
他人を信じるなって言ったはずだ。{1a}{0c:52e0e8}特に、俺達兄弟の間なんて
赤の他人より信用出来ない。
あの女好きの親父がそこら中に
子供をつくったおかげでな。{1a}{0c:52f0f8}みんな必死なんだよ。
3番目の兄貴みたいに、
親父に認められて
枢機卿になれたなら、{1a}{0c:52ff01ff09}アスロイトの四公爵に匹敵する
富が手に入るんだからな。{0c:fe}
strings.en:
{0c:52d0d8}{1c:20}Why so surprised? I told you, never trust
anyone inside the Holy See.{1a}{0c:52e0e8}Especially not among us brothers. We're
less to be trusted than total strangers,
thanks to that skirt-chasing old man of
ours siring children all over the place.{1a}{0c:52f0f8}We're all desperate. Like our third
brother, if you win the old man's favor
and become a cardinal,{1a}{0c:52ff01ff09}you get wealth to rival the four dukes
of Asroit.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Why so surprised? I told you, never trust anyone inside the Holy See. // [1]Especially not among us brothers. We're less to be trusted than total strangers, thanks to that skirt-chasing old man of ours siring children all over the place. // [2]We're all desperate. Like our third brother, if you win the old man's favor and become a cardinal, // [3]you get wealth to rival the four dukes of Asroit.

strings.jp:
{0c:52ff11ff19}{1c:20}助けを{e0d4}んでも無駄だ。
ライバルが1人減るんだ、
誰も助けになどこない。{1a}{0c:52ff21ff29}ニコラウスとアントニウスか?
奴等もこのことは知っている。
お前は奴等に裏切られたんだよ。{0c:fe}
strings.read:
{0c:52ff11ff19}{1c:20}助けを呼んでも無駄だ。
ライバルが1人減るんだ、
誰も助けになどこない。{1a}{0c:52ff21ff29}ニコラウスとアントニウスか?
奴等もこのことは知っている。
お前は奴等に裏切られたんだよ。{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Calling for help is useless. It's one less rival, so no one's coming to save you. // [1]Nicolaus and Antonius? They know about this too. They sold you out.

strings.en:
{1c:24}{0b:08}【 Dias 】{0b:09}
A worthless old tale...{0c:fe}
strings.tl: A worthless old tale...
Would you not wipe away this world so full of falsehood, [1]and create a new world?
In the 'New World', [1]neither time nor space exists... // There are no borders dividing one from another, and no sickness or death to torment mankind...
No mother to cast you away. [1]No brothers to betray you. // With the coming of the 'New World', all the accursed past you hate will be taken away.
You showed me that old tale just to say this? A tasteless production. // A pity for you. The 'New World' holds no interest for me. No, quite the reverse.
Do you fear losing your body? The body is but a chain that binds the soul. // Only by severing that chain can one at last gain true freedom, unbound by the fear of death and age.

strings.jp:
{1c:23}{0b:08}{e080} ディアス {e081}{0b:09}
それは確かに一面の{e094}理だろう。
だが、死も争いもないその世{e088}で
人間は一体何をするのだ?{1a}争いがなければ文{e0e4}の発展はない。
死の恐怖がなければ
{e0e6}としての進{e0e7}はない。{1a}それに、万人にとっての
{e097}遍的な理想など
この世には存{e08c}せぬ。{1a}{e0cb}定の人間にとって理想であっても、
他の人間にとって
それが地獄となることも
珍しくはないのだからな。{1a}{e0e9}に、{e0a6}人を分ける境{e088}が
{e0ea}全に無くなったとして、
貴様等はその世{e088}に
一体どんな理想を残すつもりだ?{0c:2b5709fe}
strings.read:
{1c:23}{0b:08}【 ディアス 】{0b:09}
それは確かに一面の真理だろう。
だが、死も争いもないその世界で
人間は一体何をするのだ?{1a}争いがなければ文明の発展はない。
死の恐怖がなければ
種としての進化はない。{1a}それに、万人にとっての
普遍的な理想など
この世には存在せぬ。{1a}特定の人間にとって理想であっても、
他の人間にとって
それが地獄となることも
珍しくはないのだからな。{1a}仮に、個人を分ける境界が
完全に無くなったとして、
貴様等はその世界に
一体どんな理想を残すつもりだ?{0c:2b5709fe}
strings.en:
{1c:23}{0b:08}【 Dias 】{0b:09}
That may well be one side of the truth.
But in a world with neither death nor
strife, what exactly would mankind do?{1a}Without strife, civilization does not
advance. Without fear of death, a
species does not evolve.{1a}Moreover, no universal ideal for all men
exists in this world.{1a}What is an ideal to one man is, often
enough, hell to another.{1a}Suppose the boundary dividing one
person from the next were gone entirely.
What ideal, exactly, do you intend to
leave in that world?{0c:2b5709fe}
strings.tl: That may well be one side of the truth. But in a world with neither death nor strife, what exactly would mankind do? // Without strife, civilization does not advance. Without fear of death, a species does not evolve. // Moreover, no universal ideal for all men exists in this world. // What is an ideal to one man is, often enough, hell to another. // Suppose the boundary dividing one person from the next were gone entirely. What ideal, exactly, do you intend to leave in that world?
You need have no fear. The 'New World' holds the ideal of every person. // Healing your parched heart with a mother's love, sating the vengeance that rules your heart: all of it can be fulfilled.

strings.read:
{1c:25}{0b:08}【 ディアス 】{0b:09}
な、何の事を言っている・・・{0c:fe}
strings.en:
{1c:25}{0b:08}【 Dias 】{0b:09}
Wh-what are you talking about...{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Wh-what are you talking about...
Why not be honest? [1]More than anyone, you long for the coming of the 'New World', do you not? // More than anyone, you starve for love, do you not?

strings.read:
{1c:25}{0b:08}【 ディアス 】{0b:09}
そ、そのような感情など・・・{0c:fe}
strings.en:
{1c:25}{0b:08}【 Dias 】{0b:09}
S-such feelings...{0c:fe}
strings.tl: S-such feelings...
Bluster is useless. // [1]We can see your panic as clear as day. For we are you yourself.
Hiding it is useless... We are the real you, held down all this time.
This is the landscape of your heart. The thirst of your heart.
The dream you see every night. [1]The desire that can never be sated.
Wh-what are you...
What a pitiful man. [1]Playing the cold-blooded man, while yearning for an imaginary mother...
Why do you call yourself Dias? [1]There are any number of false names, are there not?
You avoid other people [1]because you fear betrayal, do you not?
S-silence!!

strings.jp:
{1c:1c}{0b:08}{e080} 聖者ハンリアル {e081}{0b:09}
あなたはもうわかってるはず。
{0c:2b502351202b591000}この世{e088}に本当の安らぎなんて
あるはずのないことを。{1a}でも、『{e09f}しい世{e088}』では
みんなが分かり合える。
人を包む殻がなくなり、
1つになれる・・・{0c:fe}
strings.read:
{1c:1c}{0b:08}【 聖者ハンリアル 】{0b:09}
あなたはもうわかってるはず。
{0c:2b502351202b591000}この世界に本当の安らぎなんて
あるはずのないことを。{1a}でも、『新しい世界』では
みんなが分かり合える。
人を包む殻がなくなり、
1つになれる・・・{0c:fe}
strings.tl: You must know by now. [1]There can be no true peace in this world. // But in the 'New World', all can understand one another. The shells around people vanish, and all can become one...
In the 'New World', [1]no one will betray you. // And you and everyone will understand one another from the bottom of your hearts. // Come, make your wish. Wish for the coming of the 'New World'!

strings.en:
{0c:523840}{1c:25}{0b:08}【 Dias 】{0b:09}
Silence! I will not listen!{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Silence! I will not listen!
Begone! [1]A woman who sold her son for money, now of all times...
Begone... Just go...!!

strings.en: {1c:63}Ngh... Urgh!!{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Ngh... Urgh!!
Prophet, awaken! Open the door of the 'New World'!!
So long... Ten thousand years I have waited...
Now at last true eternity... true peace shall be ours...

strings.en:
{1c:27}{0b:08}【 Dias 】{0b:09}
I-impossible...{0c:2b5809fe}
strings.tl: I-impossible...
The one who hears the voice of the 'New World' and opens the door to the 'Land of Origin': that is the second Prophet... // You have become that Prophet. Why do you grieve?
Do you not hear it? The 'New World' stirring in the womb, and the people's cries of joy!
[HERO]! Kill me!!

strings.jp:
{1c:25}単純な答えだ!
預言者を殺せば悪魔になれる!{0c:2b572351082b501000}{0c:2b5709fe}
strings.read:
{1c:25}単純な答えだ!
預言者を殺せば悪魔になれる!{0c:2b572351082b501000}{0c:2b5709fe}
strings.en:
{1c:25}The answer is simple! Kill the Prophet,
and you can become the Devil!{0c:2b572351082b501000}{0c:2b5709fe}
strings.tl: The answer is simple! Kill the Prophet, and you can become the Devil!
Correct. To earn the right to fight God, // one must kill the Prophet, as it is written in the Scriptures.
I am prepared for death... So do it, quickly!
But until the door to the 'Land of Origin' has opened completely, that cannot be allowed.
I will not kill you. // [HERO]-kun, you still have a task once the door to the 'Land of Origin' has opened: to be the priming water that draws forth the 'New World'.

{1c:1e}{0b:08}【 聖者ウェルカイル 】{0b:09}
くっ、誰だ!?

strings.en:
{0c:52b0b8}{1c:16}{0b:08}【 Fatum the Undying 】{0b:09}
So it falls short after all...{0c:2b5a09fe}
strings.tl: So it falls short after all...
Wh-why are you here!?
Be not dismayed, Welkail. That one is a puppet with no soul... Struggle as it may, it can never become the Devil.
You seem at ease. Think you are a god already?

strings.read:
{1c:17}{10}、この槍を持て!
これで奴の心臓を貫け!{0c:2b5709fe}
strings.en:
{1c:17}{10}, take this spear! Drive it
through that one's heart!{0c:2b5709fe}
strings.tl: [HERO], take this spear! Drive it through that one's heart!
Regrettably, that one has no reason to kill the Prophet. // [1]Without a strong will, one can neither pierce the light that surrounds the Prophet nor become the Devil.

strings.jp:
{1c:1d}{0b:08}{e080} 聖者ウェルカイル {e081}{0b:09}
残念だったね。
{0c:51d02b5a1000}せめて僕の手で
2人仲良く消滅させてやるよ。
strings.read:
{1c:1d}{0b:08}【 聖者ウェルカイル 】{0b:09}
残念だったね。
{0c:51d02b5a1000}せめて僕の手で
2人仲良く消滅させてやるよ。
strings.en:

How unfortunate for you. {0c:51d02b5a1000}At the least, I

strings.tl: How unfortunate for you. [1]At the least, I will erase the two of you together with my own hand.
[HERO], kill me!!
Why do you rise? Would you kill with your own hands the comrade who has overcome hardship at your side!?

strings.read: そんなこと出来ない!!|ディアス、あなたのことは忘れない!
strings.en: I can't do that!!|I will never forget you, Dias!
strings.tl: I can't do that!!|I will never forget you, Dias!

strings.en:
{1c:26}{0b:08}【 Dias 】{0b:09}
{10}... Please... Let me sleep...{0c:fe}
strings.tl: [HERO]... Please... Let me sleep...

strings.en:
{1c:18}{0b:08}【 Fatum the Undying 】{0b:09}

strings.en:
{1c:18}{0b:08}【 Fatum the Undying 】{0b:09}
Please...
strings.tl: Please...
Forgive me, [HERO]...

strings.en:
{1c:10}{0b:08}【 Qumran 】{0b:09}
You have done very well, {10}-san.{0c:020201}
strings.tl: You have done very well, [HERO]-san.
The 'Ansur Ring' has finally proved its worth. Without it, we might not have arrived in time. // In any case, you have done very well, [HERO]-san.

strings.en:
{1c:26}{0b:08}【 Dias 】{0b:09}
A pity for you. As you see, I live.{0c:2b50235278802b511000}{0c:fe}
strings.tl: A pity for you. As you see, I live.

strings.en:
{1c:26}{0b:08}【 Dias 】{0b:09}
It appears that man deceived us.{0c:2b5309fe}
strings.tl: It appears that man deceived us.

strings.jp:

そ、そんな、
騙すつもりなんて・・・{1a}{0c:2b502351002b531000}ディアスさんには
{e0e9}死{e19c}{e19d}になってもらったのです。{1a}{0c:5170}聖{e196}の文面からこうなる事を察知し、
刺さった{e1a0}間に{e1a1}結魔{e1a2}が
{e1a3}所的に{e1a4}動する{e084}を、
ガイウスさんと{e0a3}同で造って・・・{1a}もちろん、彼らを
騙せるかどうかは賭けでしたが・・・{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.read:
{0c:528840}{1c:12}{0b:08}【 クムラン 】{0b:09}
そ、そんな、
騙すつもりなんて・・・{1a}{0c:2b502351002b531000}ディアスさんには
仮死状態になってもらったのです。{1a}{0c:5170}聖書の文面からこうなる事を察知し、
刺さった瞬間に凍結魔法が
局所的に作動する槍を、
ガイウスさんと共同で造って・・・{1a}もちろん、彼らを

strings.en:
{0c:528840}{1c:12}{0b:08}【 Qumran 】{0b:09}
N-no, I never meant to deceive you...{1a}{0c:2b502351002b531000}I put Dias-san into a state of
suspended animation.{1a}{0c:5170}The wording of the Scriptures warned
me of this, so together with Gaius-san I
made a spear that casts a freezing spell
on just the spot it pierces, the instant{1a}it strikes...{1a}Of course, whether it would deceive
them was a gamble...{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.tl: N-no, I never meant to deceive you... // [1]I put Dias-san into a state of suspended animation. // [2]The wording of the Scriptures warned me of this, so together with Gaius-san I made a spear that casts a freezing spell on just the spot it pierces, the instant it strikes... // Of course, whether it would deceive them was a gamble...

strings.en:
{1c:25}{0b:08}【 Dias 】{0b:09}
...Humiliating.{0c:2b5309fe}
strings.tl: ...Humiliating.
I am s-sorry, Dias-san, [HERO]-san. There was no time to tell you.
Come to think of it, I do not see the Undying.
Fatum-san [1]has gone up to the surface with Sadiya-san... But...

永遠の眠り、

strings.read:
{1c:12}{0b:08}【 クムラン 】{0b:09}
体の傷は治っているのですが、
意識が戻らないのです。{1a}{0c:5170}{0c:2b512351002b531000}{0c:2b502351002b531000}ファトゥムさんの望んでいた
永遠の眠り、
それがこのような形で
訪れるなんて・・・{1a}途中でファトゥムさんと

strings.tl: The wounds to his body have healed, but he has not regained consciousness. // [1]The eternal sleep Fatum-san longed for, and it should come in such a form... // I regret having lost track of Fatum-san along the way.

strings.en:
{1c:11}{0b:08}【 Qumran 】{0b:09}
Let us hurry! The door is closing!!{0c:fe}
